definition: A parallel decoding algorithm that breaks the sequential dependency of autoregressive generation by generating n-grams with lookahead branches and verifying them via a Jacobi iteration scheme.
details: Lookahead decoding maintains a pool of n-grams produced by parallel lookahead branches and uses them to propose multiple tokens per step without a draft model or extra training. A Jacobi-style fixed-point iteration verifies and combines these n-grams. The approach is implemented in the LookaheadDecoding library and yields substantial latency reductions.

citation.title: Break the Sequential Dependency of LLM Inference Using Lookahead Decoding
